title: Book that foretold the Texas Tower sniper

tellings.quote: >> And there was there was a book that uh talked about the Texas Tower sniper before it ever happened.

plain: An author on occult and intelligence history, Peter Levenda, says on a podcast hosted by Jesse Michels that there was a book which described the Texas Tower sniper, a 1966 shooting from a tower in Texas, before it ever happened. He tells it as a strange case of something written down seemingly foreseeing a real event.
